channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: Patel fires 10 FBI agents over Trump Mar-a-Lago probe
item.description: WASHINGTON >> About 10 FBI employees, some veteran agents, were dismissed this week for their work on the investigation into President Donald Trump’s retention of classified documents at Mar-a-Lago, his residence in Florida, according to five people with knowledge of the move.

item.title: Trump aims to accept 4,500 white South African refugees monthly
item.description: WASHINGTON/JOHANNESBURG >> The U.S. aims to process 4,500 refugee applications from white South Africans per month, far above President Donald Trump’s stated refugee program cap, and is installing trailers on embassy property in Pretoria to support the effort, a U.S. contracting document said.

item.title: Wall Street ends lower as tech rally stalls
item.description: NEW YORK >> U.S. stocks turned sharply lower today, the day after earnings from artificial intelligence vanguard Nvidia failed to impress investors, weighing down technology shares which have provided muscle to the recent rally.

item.title: Costco notifies Hawaii members of Yakitori fried rice recall
item.description: Costco Wholesale has notified members in Hawaii of a recall notice for Yakitori Chicken Fried Rice sold in the frozen section due to potential glass contamination.

item.title: Netflix backs out of bid for Warner Bros., paving way for Ellison
item.description: Netflix said today that it had backed away from its deal to acquire Warner Bros. Discovery, a stunning development that paves the way for the storied Hollywood media giant to end up under the control of a rival bidder, technology heir David Ellison.

item.title: Chicago honors Rev. Jesse Jackson with lineup of memorial events
item.description: CHICAGO >> Memorial events honoring the life and legacy of civil rights leader Jesse Jackson begin this week in Chicago, likely drawing elected officials, advocates and community members to celebrate a man whose decades-long activism reshaped American politics and amplified Black communities and communities of color.

item.title: Waipahu building fire sends 3 people to hospital
item.description: Honolulu firefighters are responding to a three-alarm building fire in Waipahu that sent three people to a hospital this afternoon.

item.title: Anthropic says it cannot ‘accede’ to Pentagon in talks over AI
item.description: WASHINGTON >> The standoff between the Pentagon and Anthropic over how artificial intelligence can be used in defense continued today as the AI startup reiterated its reservations, a day before a deadline imposed by the Trump administration for the company to permit its powerful technology to be applied broadly for military operations.

item.title: Road win keeps Rainbows in tie for Big West lead
item.description: The Hawaii basketball team held off UC Davis 77-73 today at University Credit Union Center in Northern California.

item.title: Rainbow Wahine pull away for win over UC Davis
item.description: Saniyah Neverson hit two quick 3-pointers to start the fourth quarter and the Hawaii women’s basketball team ran away with a 67-46 win over UC Davis tonight at Bankoh Arena at Stan Sheriff Center.
